name: lancus-partyfinder
description: Party finder, dragon leaderboard and player lookups for Lancus Addons.
comment: skyhelper-networth runs on the Worker itself. It cannot do so unmodified - prismarine-nbt builds its parser with eval() at module scope, which Workers forbid - so `alias` in wrangler.partyfinder.toml swaps it for shims/prismarine-nbt.js, which parses the same NBT with NBTify. Both dependencies are pinned exactly: the shim leans on the shape of skyhelper's helper/decode.js, and tests/nbt-shim.test.js is what says whether a bump still fits.
